[[File:Blazing_Claw_1.png|thumb|right|200px|Blazing Claw]]

The '''Blazing Claw''' was the most identifiable symbol of [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]]. It was used for thousands of years and was glamorized in countless [[Holovid/Legends|holovids]]. Over the centuries many variants of the Blazing Claw were used as countless raider groups adapted the symbol but the basic identity of the symbol remained&mdash;a claw or claws surrounded by flames.
